outcome.Summary: Implemented the full SPEC.md: store/store.go (mutex-guarded map with clock-based lazy expiry, all 12 spec'd methods incl. custom glob matcher for Keys and versioned JSON Save/Load that drops expired entries), proto/proto.go (line tokenizer with quote/escape handling, all 11 commands, response formatters with the exact quoting rules, and the specified error strings), server/server.go (Serve with per-connection goroutines, ctx-cancel cleanup of listener+conns returning nil, QUIT handling, 64 KiB line limit, CRLF stripping). Added test files for all three packages; acceptance check `go vet ./... && go test -race ./...` passes (repeated runs, no flakes), gofmt clean, committed as 5da1042.
